extracted.intended_audience: Associated Press journalists, newsroom reporters, editors, and AP staff
extracted.subtask_description: A set of Associated Press policies and principles that guide newsroom behavior and story production, covering accuracy, conflicts of interest, visuals, privacy, and other editorial concerns. The page is a hub linking to detailed guidelines (News Values and Principles, Social Media Guidelines, and topic-specific guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Report the news accurately and honestly
rubrics_metrics.description: It is our job — more than ever before — to report the news accurately and honestly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framing principle of the page; establishes accuracy and honesty as the primary obligations for AP journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telling the story
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists at The Associated Press utilize a set of standards and practices that safeguards AP stories from bias and inaccuracies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance that reporting should follow AP standards and practices designed to prevent bias and inaccuracies; detailed rules are in linked guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: AP employees must avoid behavior or activities - political, social or financial - that create a conflict of interest or compromise our ability to report the news fairly and accurately, uninfluenced by any person or action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employees should refrain from activities that would create real or perceived conflicts; covers political, social, and financial activities. Full examples and procedures likely in the linked policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary guideline category on the page; implies existence of detailed editorial standards for reporting, sourcing, verification, and writing in the downloadable News Values and Principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visuals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers standards for photography, video, captions, and other visual elements to ensure accuracy, context, and ethical presentation; full rules are in the Visuals guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses considerations about taste, dignity, and harm in reporting (e.g., coverage of victims, graphic content); detailed guidance found in the Decency policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relates to respecting individuals' privacy and handling private information responsibly; specifics are in the Privacy guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concerns ethical behavior, truthfulness, and adherence to AP's core ethical obligations; see linked material for examples and enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fabrications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates prohibition against inventing facts, quotes, or sources; aims to prevent false reporting. Details and anti-patterns would be in the Fabrications policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing favoritism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses avoiding preferential treatment or bias toward subjects, organizations, or sources; guidance and examples likely in related policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gifts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers rules on accepting gifts that could compromise or appear to compromise reporting independence; specifics (limits, reporting) are in the Gifts policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing bias
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on editorial and personal practices to avoid bias in reporting and presentation; linked guidance would provide techniques and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on employees' involvement in political activity to prevent conflicts of interest and maintain newsroom impartiality; see policy for prohibited/allowed activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses outside employment or activities that could affect AP duties or create conflicts; details in the Other Work guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freelance work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules governing AP employees doing freelance journalism or other paid work outside AP to avoid conflicts or misuse of AP material; consult the Freelance Work policy for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers expectations and rules for AP employees' use of social media in personal and professional capacities to protect accuracy, impartiality, and the AP brand; full guidance available in the downloadable document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloads (News Values and Principles)
rubrics_metrics.description: Download: News Values and Principles (page provides a downloadable full document).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that detailed, comprehensive guidance for all listed topics is available in the downloadable News Values and Principles document linked on the page.
